_comment: Doodle Wood storefront collections. Mapped to the real catalog, not the aspirational list in Notion 40 - Storefront.

collections.title: Hand-Burned Wood Slices
collections.description: The hero of the studio. Sketchbook line work burned permanently into basswood - grain lines become rivers, knots become eyes. Hand-burned one at a time, so no two are alike.

collections.title: Pendants & Wearables
collections.description: Doodles you can wear. Wood-slice pendants and embroidered badges built from the same characters that escaped the notebook - cord and iron-on backing included.

collections.title: Signs & Wall Art
collections.description: Hand-burned lettering on solid pine. Welcome signs, nameplates and wall pieces made to hang on a cabin door and stay there.

collections.title: Stickers & Camp Goods
collections.description: The small stuff. Weatherproof vinyl doodles and campfire-ready mugs - the easiest way to get a character out of the sketchbook and onto your gear.

_planned_but_not_built._reason: Named in Notion 40 - Storefront as featured collections, but no products exist for them yet.
